tools_problematic.problem: Reported WARN status=unavailable 'No build output found under bin\x64\Debug' when the dev-agent's dotnet build had emitted output under bin\Debug\net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0\win-x64 instead.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log ~turn 50: '==> Test-AppLaunch [WARN] status=unavailable / Detail : No build output found under bin\x64\Debug'. Agent recovered by using dotnet run.

tool_limitations.limitation: Only probes the bin\x64\Debug output layout; a plain `dotnet build` (no explicit -p:Platform=x64) lands binaries under bin\Debug\<tfm>\win-x64 and the launcher cannot find them.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Skill Step 3 already says to compile with `winapp build` rather than bare `dotnet build`; keep that guidance prominent so the output layout matches what Test-AppLaunch.ps1 expects.

errors_encountered.error: CS0246: The type or namespace name 'MainPage' could not be found (MainWindow.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The Windows-Universal-Samples source puts every class (MainPage, Scenario, SampleConfiguration) in `namespace SDKTemplate`, but `dotnet new winui -n CustomSensors` scaffolds App/MainWindow in `namespace CustomSensors`. The scaffold's generated references to MainPage looked in CustomSensors and could not resolve the SDKTemplate.MainPage type.
errors_encountered.fix: Align namespaces: keep the sample's `SDKTemplate` namespace on migrated files and add `using SDKTemplate;` to the scaffold's MainWindow.xaml.cs (or unify on one namespace) so MainPage resolves.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909: Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario / WMC1111: DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType / WMC1509: No LocalAssembly parameter
errors_encountered.root_cause: Same namespace mismatch cascade. The XAML compiler could not resolve `x:DataType="local:Scenario"` (local = using:SDKTemplate) because the unresolved MainPage/assembly-namespace confusion broke local-assembly type resolution. WMC1111 also flags that a DataTemplate using x:Bind must declare x:DataType.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolve the SDKTemplate vs project-namespace mismatch (above); once MainPage/x:Class namespaces are consistent, local:Scenario resolves and WMC0909/WMC1509 clear. Ensure every DataTemplate that uses x:Bind carries x:DataType.

errors_encountered.error: WMC9997: There are multiple root elements. Line 38 (Scenario1_DataEvents.xaml)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Self-inflicted: an edit to the XAML left trailing content, producing a second root element. Not a migration-pattern gap.
errors_encountered.fix: Dev-agent rewrote the file to a single root; build proceeded.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Cascade of CS0246 (MainPage) + WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC1509 XAML type-resolution errors after wiring the SDK-sample shell.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: several turns of hypothesizing about x:DataType, LocalAssembly, and assembly name before landing on the namespace mismatch
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The SDK sample's fixed `namespace SDKTemplate` (and `x:Class="SDKTemplate.MainPage"`) did not match the scaffold's project namespace (`CustomSensors`), so both C# and the XAML compiler failed to resolve MainPage/Scenario.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Kept SDKTemplate namespace on migrated files and added `using SDKTemplate;` to the scaffold-generated MainWindow.xaml.cs so cross-file references resolved.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A migration-skill note (SDK-sample section) warning that Windows-Universal-Samples put ALL code under `namespace SDKTemplate` with `x:Class="SDKTemplate.MainPage"`, which mismatches the scaffold namespace and produces CS0246 + WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC1509 — with the fix (unify the namespace / add the using).
